g.text: Recognize Luminous Mind Defiled by Incoming Defilements
Recognize Causes of Suffering (Greed, Aversion, Delusion)
Recognize Body as Afflicted, Weak, & Encumbered
Recognize World on Fire with Aging & Death
True Dhamma Does Not Last Long
Recognize Mindfulness & Alertness as Direct Path
Remain Focused on Body (ardent, alert, mindful)
Remain Focused on Feelings (ardent, alert, mindful)
Remain Focused on Mind (ardent, alert, mindful)
Remain Focused on Mental Qualities (ardent, alert, mindful)
Recognize Feelings as they Arise, Persist, Subside
Recognize Thoughts as they Arise, Persist, Subside
Recognize Perceptions as they Arise, Persist, Subside
Act with Alertness in All Daily Activities
Arouse Persistence (Abandon Unskillful, Take on Skillful)
Develop Seven Factors for Awakening (Mindfulness, Analysis, Persistence, Rapture, Calm, Concentration, Equanimity)
Achieve Lack of Clinging or Sustenance
No Seed for Future Birth, Aging, Death, or Stress
Mind Rightly Released from Effluents (Sensuality, Becoming, Ignorance)
